source: Xue et al. (2024): one JWST MIRI LRS eclipse on 1 July 2023 (GTO 1274). Eclipse depth 140 +/- 17 ppm, white light, 5 to 12 um (abstract); the range is its one-sigma interval. Radius ratio 0.04943 +/- 0.00015 (Table 1, R_P/R_*), fitted with the depth. The paper finds the day side only one sigma below the hottest a bare rock can be, and concludes the planet likely has no significant atmosphere. https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.13340
